title: "descriptive_stats"
output: pdf_document
date: "2025-11-19"
---

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(data.table)   # fread
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)          # datatable output
library(scales)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(plotly)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggExtra)

# Paths to CSVs (adjust if needed)

md_csv = "../metadata_enriched.csv"

metadata <- fread(md_csv)
metadata <- metadata[ IS_VALID ==T]
pdf(w=6, h=6)
ggplot(metadata, aes(ROI_SIZE_MM , DRYMASS_MG^(1/3),shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) + 
  geom_point(alpha=.3)  + geom_smooth(col="black", method = "lm") +
  facet_grid(DATASET ~ .) + theme_classic()


ggplot(metadata, aes( BF_cbrMG_MM, ROI_SIZE_MM,shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) + 
  geom_point(alpha=.3)  + geom_smooth(col="black")+
  facet_grid(DATASET ~ .)  + theme_classic() 


ggplot(metadata, aes( BF_cbrMG_MM,shape=DATASET, fill=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) + 
  geom_density( alpha=.5) + theme_classic()
  

dev.off()
```
